items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: In a heroic effort to save the critically endangered Madagascar pochard, conservationists embarked on a challenging 44 km trek to rescue vulnerable eggs from their rain-soaked nests. From Lake Matsaborimena, they carefully retrieved 15 eggs and transported them to a breeding facility in Antsohihy. Their dedication bore fruit as six eggs successfully hatched, contributing to increasing the population of this rare duck species, now numbering around 180 individuals.

items.description: On November 21, 1963, India launched its first sounding rocket from Thumba, establishing its space program. items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: A family in Kansas spotted a rare piebald black bear while harvesting crops in their field. Wildlife biologists explained that young bears often disperse in search of food and territory.
